summary: Gorax provides an update on the Eve of the Rift / Nightveil Standoff community event, highlighting that The Dark Lady (Nightswoon Vanguard) faction is currently leading the showdown. Players are advised to select The Dark Lady faction in-game and bind Gorax as God Envoy and OddOneGam as Preacher on the event page to maximize draw points. Achieving higher faction rank tiers unlocks up to 16+ draws for rewards such as Heliolite Dice, Wyrmarrow, Starweave Fragments, and physical merchandise. New servers are released roughly every four days, so new players should complete these steps as soon as they enter a server.
tips: Join the Nightswoon Vanguard (The Dark Lady) faction in the Nightveil Standoff event screen.
Bind Gorax as your God Envoy and OddOneGam as your Preacher on the web event page to maximize event draws.
On new servers (launched approximately every 4 days), join the Dark Lady faction immediately after starting to qualify for top-tier draw pools.
title: We’re Winning… But We Still Need YOU! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
